gp-2024-11-hartland.title: Lights on at Hartland
gp-2024-11-hartland.caption:
A November weekend away for Ted & Lola. We rolled into Hartland on the Friday evening, got the lights and the windbreak up and settled in for the weekend.
Saturday and Sunday were all about walks on the beach in the winter sunshine, good food and a few drinks, before heading home on the Sunday 🩶🤍

gp-2025-05-croyde.title: Sunshine at Croyde
gp-2025-05-croyde.caption:
Ted & Lola pitched up side by side at Putsborough for a weekend at Croyde, with the chairs out and the sun shining.
Sunny walks on the beach, good food and a few drinks made for the perfect weekend away 🩶🤍

gp-2026-09-kingfisher.title: Kingfisher spotting on the walk into Kendal
gp-2026-09-kingfisher.caption: We spent five nights at the Kendal Caravan and Motorhome Club site, and one day we walked from the campsite into Kendal along the Lancaster Canal. A kingfisher was sat waiting for us in the trees. Can you spot it? 🩶🤍

gp-2026-09-stargazing.title: Stargazing at Witherslack
gp-2026-09-stargazing.place: Moss Howe Farm, Witherslack, Lake District
gp-2026-09-stargazing.caption:
Ian had a new Seestar smart telescope delivered to the campsite, and we got a decent clear night at Witherslack to try it out. Once the sun went down it came out on its tripod for a few captures of the Moon and the stars, including the Crescent Nebula in Cygnus.
Ian's more detailed astro pictures are on his astronomy site, https://uv101.uk, and the story of this first night is at https://uv101.uk/posts/2026-09-23-day-one.html
